source_handle: *47 Unscrew the healing cap, rinse and dry the area. Screw in the implant abutment and take a picture to confirm that the abutment is in place. The edges of all-ceramic crowns have good adhesion and good adjacency. Blended and polished. The patient was satisfied with the shape and color of the restoration. After confirmation, the abutment was torqued 25Ncm. White raw tape seals the screw holes, and the upper resin seals the screw holes.
